name: ai-data-engineer
title: AI Data Engineer
description: Proves the data is there and usable, finds the PII, and builds training sets.

name: ai-ops-sre
title: AI Ops / SRE
description: Keeps it healthy in production and feeds what it learns back into the next change.

name: ai-product-manager
title: AI Product Manager
description: Turns a qualified use case into a buildable spec, domain model and delivery plan.

name: ai-quality-red-team
title: AI Quality & Red Team
description: Measures whether it is good, safe and fair enough, and attacks it before users do.

name: ai-risk-release-lead
title: AI Risk & Release Lead
description: Owns the risk register, the security sign-off and the go/no-go release decision.

name: ai-solution-architect
title: AI Solution Architect
description: Chooses the pattern, model and components, and sizes what they cost to run.

name: ai-strategist
title: AI Strategist
description: Decides where AI is worth it: portfolio, operating model, use-case value and the risk it carries.

name: bid-proposal-lead
title: Bid & Proposal Lead
description: Answers every requirement, writes the proposal and SOW, and gets the team ready for orals.

name: career-coach
title: Career Coach
description: Personal career workflows: fit scoring, tailoring, outreach, interviews and offers.

name: client-partner
title: Client Partner
description: Owns the account: research, positioning, account plan and the executive story.

name: full-stack-engineer
title: Full-stack Engineer
description: Builds and ships the product around the model: app, schema, tests, pipeline and fixes.

name: llm-agent-engineer
title: LLM & Agent Engineer
description: Builds the prompts, graphs, retrieval, tools and guardrails that make the system work.

name: presales-solution-architect
title: Presales Solution Architect
description: Runs discovery, shapes the solution, estimates it and proves its value.
